_doc: New-player start (D-039). prologue = the scripted 'Patient Zero' run (a mode built from base_mode + overrides; waves_overrides merge into waves). Beats run in order: start actions, an optional repeating spawn, then wait until one condition (relative to the beat's start) or max_s. Conditions: moved (px), kills, picks, dashes, chests, evolved, streak (best), outbreaks, boss_killed, claims, conversions, orders, on_pad, towers, time. Prompt targets: move, upgrade, dash, outbreak, orders, loop, pad, none. slowmo = the run slows to a crawl until the condition is met. coaches = short beat lists for the first real run of a mode. unlocks = what the menu shows when (runs = real runs, the prologue doesn't count).
